## New: Live Sets

A list of your sets that shows only the **latest saved version** of each. Open it from the tray menu (**Live Sets…**) or the **Live Sets** button in the browser.

- **Recently opened:** every set you've opened in Live. It starts with Live's own recent-sets list, and Live Versions adds each set it sees open in Live from then on.
- **In folders:** add the folders where you keep your projects, and it lists every set in them and their subfolders, most recently saved first. Live's Backup folders and the Samples folders are skipped.
- Each set has **View** (its versions and change notes) and **Open in Live**. Right-click for **Show in folder**, or to remove a set from the recent list.
- **One per project folder** (on by default) shows only the most recently saved set of each project. Untick it to see every set separately, e.g. a radio edit and an extended mix.
- **Filter** finds sets by name or folder.

## The browser opens on the right thing

Clicking the tray icon or pressing **Ctrl+Alt+V** still shows the versions of the set that's open in Live. With no set open, or Live not running, it now shows **Live Sets**, and switches to a set's versions as soon as you open one in Live.

## Fixed

**Show in folder** opened your Documents folder instead of the set's folder whenever the path had a space in it.

## Also

`LiveVersions sets` on the command line lists the latest version of each set you've opened, or of each set in the folders you give it.
